fields.quoted_span:
It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use a coordinated pricing algorithm described 
in subsection A when setting rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in 
the City of Berkeley.
fields.note: Sale/license prohibition, landlord use prohibition, definitions, per-month/per-unit violations, enforcement and the no-rent-regulation statement all match the ordinance text.

fields.quoted_span:
civil penalties of up to $1,000 
per violation.
fields.note: Penalty cap, separate violations per month and unit, 90-day Competitor Data definition, and mandatory fees ("shall award") to a prevailing City Attorney or tenant all match.
The field is null, and D001 states no effective date; it records only that the ordinance was passed to print on November 18, 2025.

fields.quoted_span:
this Ordinance was passed to print and ordered published by posting by the 
following vote:
fields.note: D001 shows only that the ordinance was passed to print. It does not state that the ordinance is in force. The in_force status rests on outside material (DX06) and cannot be confirmed from this document.

fields.quoted_span: levels that may be achieved for residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley.
fields.note: The ordinance covers residential dwelling units in Berkeley and states no unit-count, age, or owner-type limits. The exclusions are in the definition, not in the coverage.

fields.quoted_span: 13.63.030   Use and sale of coordinated pricing algorithms prohibited.
fields.note: Section 13.63.030 contains the prohibition. The aliases (ch. 13.63, §§ 13.63.020 and .040, Ordinance No. 7,992-N.S.) all appear in the document.
